author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: অনুচ্ছেদটি পড়ে নিজের ভাষায় সংক্ষিপ্তসার (summary) লেখো। নিজে লেখার পর নমুনা ও checklist দেখো (Board: 10 marks)।

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Punctuality is the habit of doing things at the right time. A punctual man values every moment. He never puts off his work for the future. Students who are punctual can finish their studies in time and do well in the examination. On the other hand, those who are not punctual always fall behind. So, we should form the habit of punctuality from an early age.'
items.model: Punctuality means doing every work at the proper time. A punctual person values time and never delays his duties, so he does well in life and studies. Those who lack this habit always lag behind. Therefore, we should be punctual from childhood.
rubric: মূল ভাব ঠিক রেখেছি, উদাহরণ কমিয়েছি

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Patriotism is one of the noblest human virtues. It is the love for one's own country. A patriot loves his country more than his own life. He is always ready to sacrifice everything for its honour. History shows that patriots have made their countries great. Without patriotism, no nation can prosper. So, every citizen should be a true patriot.'
items.model: Patriotism, the love for one's country, is a noble virtue. A patriot loves his motherland more than his life and is ready to sacrifice everything for its honour. Patriots have made nations great, for no country can prosper without patriotism. So everyone should love his country truly.
rubric: মূল ভাব ঠিক রেখেছি, উদাহরণ কমিয়েছি

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Reading books is a good habit. Books are our best friends. They give us knowledge and pleasure. A good book is a source of wisdom. It helps us to build our character and to know the world. Those who read good books can never feel lonely. So, we should read good books regularly to enrich our minds.'
items.model: Reading books is a good habit, for books are our best friends that give both knowledge and pleasure. Good books make us wise, build our character and help us know the world, so a reader is never lonely. Hence, we should read good books regularly.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Industry is the secret of success. No one can prosper in life without hard work. The great men of the world became great by dint of their industry. An idle man can never do anything great. He depends on luck and wastes his time. But an industrious man makes proper use of his time and wins success at last.'
items.model: Industry is the key to success, for no one can prosper without hard work. Great people became great through their labour, while an idle man, depending on luck, wastes his time and achieves nothing. An industrious man uses time well and finally succeeds.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'A mother's love is the purest of all loves. She loves her child without any hope of return. She spends sleepless nights for the comfort of her child. She bears all pains with a smiling face. No love in the world can be compared with a mother's love. So, we should respect and serve our mother.'
items.model: A mother's love is the purest love, for she loves her child without expecting anything in return. She passes sleepless nights and bears all pains cheerfully for her child's comfort. No love equals a mother's love, so we should respect and serve her.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Good manners are very important in our social life. A man of good manners is liked by all. He is polite and gentle in his behaviour. He respects the elders and loves the young. Good manners cost nothing but win everything. A rude man, on the other hand, is disliked by all. So, we should learn good manners.'
items.model: Good manners are essential in social life. A well-mannered person is polite, respects elders and loves the young, so everyone likes him. Good manners cost nothing yet win all hearts, whereas a rude man is disliked by all. Therefore, we should learn good manners.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Perseverance is a great virtue. It means steady effort to reach a goal. The man who perseveres never gives up hope. He tries again and again until he succeeds. King Robert Bruce won at last through perseverance. Nothing is impossible for a man of perseverance. So, we should not lose heart in our work.'
items.model: Perseverance means making steady efforts to reach a goal. A persevering man never loses hope but tries repeatedly until he succeeds, as Robert Bruce did. Nothing is impossible for such a person, so we should never lose heart in our work.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'A morning walk is a good habit. In the morning the air is fresh and pure. A walk in this fresh air keeps our body and mind fit. It costs nothing but does much good to health. People of all ages can enjoy a morning walk. It also gives us a chance to see the beauty of nature. So, we should walk every morning.'
items.model: A morning walk is a healthy habit. The fresh, pure morning air keeps our body and mind fit and costs nothing. People of all ages can enjoy it and also see the beauty of nature. Therefore, we should take a walk every morning.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Dignity of labour means that all kinds of work are honourable. No work is small or mean. A man who works with his own hands is worthy of respect. In many countries people do not feel ashamed to do manual work. But in our country many educated people dislike manual labour. This idea should be changed.'
items.model: Dignity of labour means every kind of honest work is respectable and no job is mean. One who works with his own hands deserves respect, as people in many countries believe. Unfortunately, many educated people here dislike manual work, and this attitude must change.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Courtesy is a great quality. It means polite behaviour towards others. A courteous man speaks softly and behaves gently. He never hurts others by his words. Courtesy wins the hearts of all. It makes our social life sweet and peaceful. A discourteous man, on the other hand, is hated by all. So, we should be courteous.'
items.model: Courtesy is polite behaviour towards others. A courteous person speaks softly, behaves gently and never hurts anyone, so he wins all hearts and makes social life sweet and peaceful. A discourteous man is hated by all; therefore, we should be courteous.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Tree plantation is very important for us. Trees are our best friends. They give us oxygen, food and shade. They save us from floods and keep the soil firm. They also cause rainfall and keep the air fresh. If we cut down trees, the country will turn into a desert. So, we should plant more and more trees.'
items.model: Tree plantation is very important because trees are our friends that give oxygen, food and shade. They prevent floods, hold the soil, cause rainfall and keep the air fresh. Cutting them down may turn the country into a desert, so we should plant more trees.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Honesty is a great virtue. An honest man is respected by all. He never tells a lie or does any wrong. He fears none but his conscience. Honesty brings peace of mind. A dishonest man may prosper for a while, but he cannot be happy. So, we should be honest in all our dealings.'
items.model: Honesty is a great virtue that wins everyone's respect. An honest man never lies or does wrong and fears only his conscience, so he enjoys peace of mind. A dishonest man may prosper briefly but is never happy. Hence, we should always be honest.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'The value of time is very great. Time once gone never comes back. Every moment of our life is precious. Those who waste time repent in the long run. The great men of the world made proper use of their time. If we want to be successful, we must value every moment. So, we should not waste our time.'
items.model: Time is very valuable, for once gone it never returns and every moment is precious. Those who waste it repent later, while great people succeeded by using time properly. To be successful we must value every moment; therefore, we should never waste time.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Cleanliness is very important for good health. A clean man is free from many diseases. We should keep our body, clothes and house clean. We should also keep our surroundings neat and tidy. Dirty places breed germs and spread diseases. Cleanliness is next to godliness. So, we should be clean in every way.'
items.model: Cleanliness is essential for good health, for a clean person avoids many diseases. We should keep our body, clothes, house and surroundings neat, since dirty places breed germs and spread illness. As cleanliness is next to godliness, we should be clean in every way.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Female education is very important for a nation. Women are half of our population. If they remain uneducated, the nation cannot go forward. An educated mother can bring up her children well. She can also help her family in many ways. So, we should give equal chances of education to our girls.'
items.model: Female education is vital because women form half the population, and an uneducated half keeps the nation backward. An educated mother rears her children well and helps her family in many ways. Therefore, girls should be given equal opportunities for education.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Games and sports are essential for us. They keep our body strong and healthy. They also refresh our mind after hard study. Through games we learn discipline and team spirit. They teach us to obey rules and to work together. A sound mind lives in a sound body. So, we should take part in games.'
items.model: Games and sports are essential as they keep the body strong and refresh the mind after study. Through them we learn discipline, team spirit and obedience to rules. Since a sound mind lives in a sound body, we should take part in games.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Charity is a noble virtue. It means love and kindness for others. A charitable man helps the poor and the distressed. He shares the sufferings of others. Charity gives him real happiness. It is said that charity begins at home. So, we should be charitable to all around us.'
items.model: Charity, meaning love and kindness for others, is a noble virtue. A charitable person helps the poor and distressed and shares their sufferings, which gives him true happiness. As charity begins at home, we should be charitable to all around us.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Self-help is the best help. God helps those who help themselves. A man who depends on others can never be great. He loses his confidence and becomes weak. But a self-reliant man solves his own problems. He wins success by his own efforts. So, we should learn to help ourselves.'
items.model: Self-help is the best help, for God helps those who help themselves. One who depends on others loses confidence and grows weak, while a self-reliant man solves his own problems and succeeds through his own efforts. So we should learn to help ourselves.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'The internet has brought a great change in our life. It is a huge network of computers. Through it we can get information within a moment. Students can learn many things using the internet. But it has some bad sides too. Some people misuse it and waste their time. So, we should use the internet wisely.'
items.model: The internet, a vast network of computers, has greatly changed our life by giving information instantly and helping students learn much. However, it has bad sides too, as some misuse it and waste time. Therefore, we should use the internet wisely.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'Obedience is a great virtue. It means doing what we are told by our elders. An obedient child is loved by all. He obeys his parents and teachers. He also obeys the rules of his school. Obedience helps us to build a good character. A disobedient child suffers in life. So, we should be obedient.'
items.model: Obedience means doing what our elders tell us and is a great virtue. An obedient child, loved by all, obeys his parents, teachers and school rules, which helps him build a good character. A disobedient child suffers in life, so we should be obedient.

items.prompt: Summarise: 'A newspaper plays an important role in modern life. It brings us news of home and abroad. It helps us to know about politics, sports and trade. By reading newspapers we can form our own opinion. A man without newspaper is like a frog in a well. So, we should read newspapers every day.'
items.model: A newspaper plays an important role in modern life by bringing news from home and abroad and informing us about politics, sports and trade. It helps us form our own opinions, and a man without it is like a frog in a well. So we should read it daily.
